per_hop.query:
SELECT host_name, COUNT(show_id) as total_shows_hosted
FROM TV_shows
JOIN Appearances ON TV_shows.show_id = Appearances.show_id
JOIN Hosts ON TV_shows.host_id = Hosts.host_id
WHERE Appearances.performer_name = "Paul Melba"
  AND TV_shows.country = "United Kingdom"
GROUP BY host_name
HAVING total_shows_hosted = 23;
